known_runtime_findings.title: Hades Reach Charrogg walked into geometry; encounter behavior not accepted
known_runtime_findings.observed: Stock-client report: the Behemoth attempted to engage but walked forward into a wall; no weapon attacks or slot-item effects worked, then the fight disconnected.
known_runtime_findings.cause: The preview process was run with MPGS_BEHEMOTH_ENGINE=0, which bypasses the behavior director. This explains absent behavior-tree attacks, but does not by itself explain the wall path or client disconnect.
known_runtime_findings.correction: The preview launcher no longer forces the engine off. The current run must be confirmed with an ENCOUNTER engine on log before attributing subsequent behavior.
known_runtime_findings.validation: No stock-client retest after the launcher correction is recorded. Pathing, wall collision, attacks, and disconnect remain open acceptance checks.
evidence: Phoenix source: start-server.ps1 previewserver environment; GameServer/mpgs/island_encounter.py BehemothDirector integration
next_checks: Confirm the selected preview process logs ENCOUNTER engine on for sally_normal
Observe whether the Charrogg turns, navigates around geometry, and executes an attack
Capture the client disconnect reason and server traceback if the session ends

known_runtime_findings.title: Preview quick-item activation and weapon-part setup encountered missing GUID allocator
known_runtime_findings.observed: The preview server raised KeyError: 'guids' in handle_ability while spawning the Frostbite Pylon; the same preview log reported weapon-part setup failing with KeyError: 'guids'.
known_runtime_findings.cause: The engine-disabled preview path did not initialize the encounter GUID allocator, while some actor-spawn paths assumed enc['guids'] already existed.
known_runtime_findings.correction: mpgs/engine/quick_items.py now lazily creates a GuidSource for authored quick-item actors. Other direct enc['guids'] consumers remain in island_encounter.py and have not been audited or validated under the same path.
known_runtime_findings.validation: The pylon helper correction is present in source, but no post-correction stock-client activation is recorded. Weapon-part setup remains explicitly unresolved.
evidence: Phoenix source: GameServer/mpgs/engine/quick_items.py _live_guids; GameServer/mpgs/island_encounter.py direct enc['guids'] spawn callsites
next_checks: Rejoin Island P and activate Frostbite Pylon; confirm actor/effect, charge decrement, and no traceback
